_comment: The radio. A channel is an addressable endpoint that agents subscribe to; tuning to one and transmitting decides WHO answers, and after that the identical reason/speak pipeline runs that a face-to-face conversation runs. The radio adds routing, not a second pipeline.
_presentation: This file is the RPG mod's data, not the core's. What a channel is called, who is on it and how it is tuned belongs here; the core only answers 'who is on channel 3 and can they hear me'.

_fields.private: true = you talking to something with no body (your assistant). Range and liveness cannot apply and are not consulted -- that one flag is the whole difference between calling your assistant and calling a scav.
_fields.rangeM: how far the set carries, for world agents. Needs the host-side bot census (distanceM) to mean anything; see DESIGN.md §3.5.
_fields.members: in order. The first member whose presence resolves 'ok' answers.
